sinopsis.es: Julio de 2023. Nagorno-Karabaj lleva siete meses bajo el asedio de Azerbaiyán. Ante la inminencia de la guerra, el realizador pide a su amigo Artsiv que filme su vida cotidiana con su familia. De esas imágenes tiernas emerge la resistencia silenciosa de un pueblo al borde de abandonar su hogar para siempre.
sinopsis.en: July 2023. Nagorno-Karabakh has been under siege by Azerbaijan for seven months. As war draws nearer, Comes Chahbazian asks his friend Artziv to film his daily life with his wife Tatev and their five children.
